decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble an infect combo to deal damage to the opponent's life total using creatures such as Glistener Elf, Blighted Agent, and Skrelx, Defector Mite. The deck utilizes various spells like Invigorate, Berserk, and Scale Up to pump up the infect creatures and close out the game as quickly as possible. Supporting cards like Noble Hierarch, Force of Will, and Brainstorm help to protect and enable the combo. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements while also providing additional infect sources with Inkmoth Nexus.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands and synergistic cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy and eventually win the game through a grindy, attrition-based approach. The deck aims to lock down the opponent with cards like Maze of Ith and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale while generating value and advantage through cards like Life from the Loam and Urza's Saga. By utilizing a mix of land destruction, utility lands, and versatile threats, this deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a slow, methodical manner.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful spells and efficient creatures. It utilizes a wide range of cards to handle different situations, from removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to counter spells like Force of Will. The deck also includes strong creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Ice-Fang Coatl to apply pressure and generate value. With access to a diverse mana base and powerful companions like Yorion, Sky Nomad, this control deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using Painter's Servant to change all cards in the opponent's deck to a single color, then using Grindstone to mill their entire library in one shot. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Thought Monitor and Thoughtcast provide card draw to find combo pieces quickly. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts such as Grindstone and Pithing Needle. Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke provide protection and disruption, ensuring the combo can be pulled off successfully.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize fast mana resources and efficient ramp spells to quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with high-impact combo cards such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Aurora Phoenix. By leveraging the powerful acceleration provided by cards like Creative Technique and Let the Galaxy Burn, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and end the game before they have a chance to respond. This strategy allows the deck to take advantage of the combo potential inherent in the Mississippi River archetype and secure quick victories in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently and quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game using the Doomsday card. This involves setting up the perfect sequence of cards in your library to guarantee a victory when Doomsday is cast. The deck utilizes various cheap or free spells to accelerate and protect the combo, while also running disruption to control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win the game by casting Doomsday and then using Thassa's Oracle to win the game with an empty library.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures early in the game to put pressure on the opponent and maintain control of the battlefield. With the ability to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, this deck aims to establish dominance with cards like Elite Spellbinder and Palace Jailer. By utilizing disruption cards like Chalice of the Void and efficient mana sources like Lotus Petal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through efficient use of resources.

The deck's main focus is to quickly assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with powerful hate cards like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast. The deck takes advantage of fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal to accelerate the combo and utilizes Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for key pieces. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Chaos Defiler provide additional removal options while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck is a highly synergistic combo deck with disruptive elements.

This control deck focuses on gaining card advantage, disrupting the opponent's game plan, and managing the board while setting up its own win conditions. It aims to control the game through cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Prismatic Ending, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. The deck also takes advantage of powerful draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to sculpt its hand and find key pieces. With a mixture of removal, card advantage, and powerful threats, this deck looks to outlast and outplay its opponents in a grindy game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent and gain control of the game. By utilizing cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Winota, Joiner of Forces, the deck looks to put pressure on the opponent early on. With the help of mana acceleration cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck can play its threats faster than traditional decks. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while Cavern of Souls ensures that your creatures can't be countered. Overall, the deck aims to push the tempo and dictate the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the manipulation of lands. By using cards like Exploration and Life from the Loam, the player can repeatedly play and reuse powerful lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create unstoppable threats. Additionally, cards like Maze of Ith and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale help control the opponent's board while Mox Diamond and Crop Rotation provide mana acceleration and flexibility. Overall, this deck aims to dominate the game by leveraging powerful land interactions and control elements.

This deck focuses on assembling the Dark Depths combo by combining Thespian's Stage with Dark Depths to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith, Crop Rotation, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for the combo pieces quickly. Additionally, cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Mox Diamond help ramp and generate mana to speed up the combo. The deck also includes disruption and protection elements like Swords to Plowshares and Sylvan Safekeeper to control the game and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. It combines efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares with powerful creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Questing Beast to create a fast and resilient aggro strategy. The inclusion of cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Endurance allows for added versatility and disruption, while also capitalizing on the synergy between creatures like Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes and Noble Hierarch. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also providing flexibility and consistency.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. The deck includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for and recur key combo pieces, while also packing disruption in the form of Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently controlling the board and creating a winning condition.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's deck quickly and win the game. The deck includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to help tutor for combo pieces, along with disruption cards like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The deck also has mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly assemble the combo. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and efficient in executing its win condition through the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo.

The deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play as quickly as possible by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. It also has counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its game-winning combos, along with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to help with consistency. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its big creatures and win the game before the opponent has a chance to react effectively, creating a fast and powerful win condition.
